time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; frame for time t = round(t * fps)
units: pixels (full 1920x1080 image coords, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed
scene_summary: Camera is rotated 90 deg: a hand at the left edge holds an Evian-type plastic water bottle (blue cap, white/pink label) horizontally against a grey wall, releases it, the bottle FALLS toward image +x (gravity points to image +x / right), hits the black skirting board / floor at about frame 52-53, tumbles ~210 deg clockwise, lands on the wooden floor (right side of the image) and then rolls slowly toward the image top until the end. Evidence for gravity = +x: after release the bottle's per-frame x displacement grows linearly (12, 26, 38, 51, 64, 76, 90, 101, 114, 123, 135, 145, 150 px/frame for frames 41..53), i.e. a constant pixel acceleration, with the hand left behind.
gravity_direction_in_image: +x (to the right); 'up' in the world = image -x

camera.drift_vs_frame0_px: dx 0 -> -19 px (frames 0->75, then ~-18..-19), dy 0 -> ~+4..+6 px (y weakly constrained; frame 85 value +16 is suspect). Rotation < 0.15 deg.
camera.zoom: none: black skirting strip width is constant 132-137 px at rows 150/540/950 in all frames
camera.file: tracks/camera_shift.csv (frame, dx_px, dy_px, rot_deg; x_frame = R x_frame0 + (dx,dy))
camera.note: drift is ~0.2 px/frame, about 1% of the fall motion; bottle.csv gives both raw and drift-compensated (stab) centres

objects.name: bottle
objects.description: clear plastic water bottle (Evian-like) with a blue screw cap, white label with pink 'evian' lettering on the other side; the only free-moving object
objects.visible_frames: 0-93 (whole clip); cap partly covered by fingers 0-39; base end leaves the top of the frame from frame 84 (bottle partially outside the image 84-93)
objects.reference_point: center_x/center_y = visible geometric centre of the bottle = cap end + 130 px along the bottle axis (half of the 260 px cap-to-base length)

size_px.length_cap_end_to_base: 260 px (258 +-4 held horizontal frames 0-39, e.g. frame 15: x 120..378; 263 at frame 72 on the floor, vertical). Use 260 px as the bottle's pixel length in the fall plane.
size_px.diameter: about 70 px (+-8) in the held / falling phase (frame 15 top edge y 547, bottom edge ~617; lower edge merges with its shadow); on the floor it looks wider: ~85 px at frame 72, ~108 px at frame 82 (perspective, see notes)
size_px.length_on_floor_late: apparent length grows on the floor: ~255 px (frame 66) -> ~263 (72) -> ~273 (82) as the bottle rolls toward the image top (closer to the camera)
size_px.foreshortened_during_tumble: frames 54-57 apparent length only 228-238 px (bottle tipped out of the image plane while bouncing)

objects.name: hand_arm
objects.description: person's right hand/forearm entering from the left image edge (light skin, white/beige wrist band)
objects.visible_frames: 0-93; holds the bottle 0-39 (fingertips around x 100-140, y 520-600), then rests at the left edge (x < ~110) until ~84, then the arm swings into the lower-left area (y ~620-1080, x up to ~290) frames ~85-93

objects.name: wall
objects.description: light grey painted surface filling x < ~1380 (the plane the bottle falls along); small dark marks e.g. near (675,70), (750,535), (1020,655); a faint horizontal seam/line at y ~365-375 from x ~950 to the skirting

objects.name: skirting_board
objects.description: black vertical strip (skirting board / floor edge) between wall and wooden floor
objects.size_px: width 132-137 px (constant over the clip); length = full frame height 1080 px; tilted ~1.4 deg from the image vertical

objects.name: wooden_floor
objects.description: light-brown wood (planks run along image y) right of the black strip, x > ~1520-1540 at frame 0; the bottle lands and rolls here

events.name: held_at_rest
events.note: bottle held still; cap creeps ~14 px to the left (134 -> 120) as the hand adjusts

events.name: release_start_of_fall
events.note: cap x 120.5 (f39), 121.4 (f40), 133.3 (f41): motion starts between frames 39 and 41; a constant-acceleration fit to the cap x positions places zero velocity at frame ~39.5 (t ~1.32 s)

events.name: free_fall
events.note: falls toward +x; centre y drifts slightly up the image (578 -> 557); bottle axis rotates clockwise 1 deg -> 25 deg

events.name: impact_with_skirting_floor
events.note: base end crosses the black strip edge (x ~1368) between frames 52 and 53; x motion stops abruptly after frame 53 (centre x 1356 -> 1372 -> 1368)

events.name: tumble_bounce
events.note: bottle spins clockwise ~25 -> 236 deg, appears foreshortened (tipped out of plane) frames 54-57; centre x nearly constant 1358-1386, centre moves up the image (y 557 -> 352)

events.name: lands_on_wood_floor
events.note: bottle settles with axis ~265 deg (cap toward image bottom, base toward image top)

events.name: rolling_on_floor
events.note: slow steady motion toward the image top-right (centre (1492,242) at f66 -> (1640,111) at f93); continues to the end of the clip

events.name: arm_swings_in
events.note: the person's arm moves into the lower-left of the frame

files.tracks/bottle.csv: per-frame bottle centre, cap, cap end, base end, axis angle, mask bbox/extents, occlusion, blur
files.tracks/hand.csv: per-frame skin bbox of the hand/arm
files.tracks/camera_shift.csv: per-frame camera drift relative to frame 0
